title: Ribosome profiling reveals the fine-tuned response of Escherichia coli to mild and severe acid stress.
authors: Schumacher, Kilian; Gelhausen, Rick; Kion-Crosby, Willow; Barquist, Lars; Backofen, Rolf; Jung, Kirsten
one_liner_zh: 该文用核糖体图谱和RNA测序研究大肠杆菌酸胁迫的转录与翻译适应，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且方法为测序与机器学习，非AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Bacteria react very differently to survive in acidic environments, such as the human gastrointestinal tract. Escherichia coli is one of the extremely acid-resistant bacteria and has a variety of acid-defense mechanisms. Here, we provide the first genome-wide overview of the adaptations of E. coli K-12 to mild and severe acid stress at both the transcriptional and translational levels. Using ribosome profiling and RNA sequencing, we uncover novel adaptations to different degrees of acidity, including previously hidden stress-induced small proteins and novel key transcription factors for acid defense, and report mRNAs with pH-dependent differential translation efficiency. In addition, we distinguish between acid-specific adaptations and general stress response mechanisms using denoising autoencoders. This workflow represents a powerful approach that takes advantage of next-generation sequencing techniques and machine learning to systematically analyze bacterial stress responses.
abstract_zh: 细菌在酸性环境（如人类胃肠道）中生存时反应差异显著。大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）是极端耐酸细菌之一，拥有多种酸防御机制。在此，我们提供了首个全基因组层面的概述，涵盖大肠杆菌K-12在转录和翻译水平上对轻度和重度酸胁迫的适应。利用核糖体图谱分析（ribosome profiling）和RNA测序（RNA sequencing），我们揭示了针对不同酸度水平的新适应机制，包括先前隐藏的胁迫诱导小蛋白和新型关键酸防御转录因子，并报告了具有pH依赖性差异翻译效率的mRNA。此外，我们通过去噪自编码器（denoising autoencoders）区分了酸特异性适应与一般应激反应机制。该工作流程代表了一种强大方法，利用下一代测序技术和机器学习系统分析细菌应激反应。
